alex_support: hey @jorge — saw your support ticket about 404s + undefined params when calling the Node TS client. Can you paste the minimal repro and your package.json?
jorge_customer: thanks @alex, here's the snippet that fails for us (using 0.22.0):
```js
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
await client.chat.create({ model: 'rwd-small', messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'hi' }] });
```
we get a 404 and the error body is `{"error":"route_not_found","route":"chat.create"}`.
alex_support: ok, two quick checks — are you on TS/Node SDK 0.22.0 exactly? and is the API host custom (VPC) or hosted?
jorge_customer: yes 0.22.0, hosted (api.redwood.ai). We tried npm i @redwood/inference@latest and same error. Also noticed some params are undefined in logs (e.g. `model` becomes `undefined` in payload).
lee_sdk: jumping in — thanks for the repro. We shipped a route renaming on the backend last week (internal name change chat.create -> chat.generate) and published a compatibility shim to the SDK in 0.23.x. If your install is 0.22.0 the local route map doesn't include the new name and the client tries to call the old route which returns 404.
nina_backend: to add — the backend accepted both names briefly during rollout but our faster-onboarding customers hit caching edge cases; some edge caches still reject chat.create. We rolled a fix to allow both for another 48h but recommend SDK update.
jorge_customer: hmm we thought latest would get it but package.json locked to 0.22.0 in our deploy pipeline. Any immediate workaround without changing pipeline?
lee_sdk: two options: 1) pin to the SDK patch that contains the compatibility shim (upgrade to `@redwood/inference@0.23.1`) — recommended. 2) temporary REST fallback — call the endpoint directly with curl using the new route name `chat.generate` and `model_name` param (backend accepts this form). Example curl: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat.generate 
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY" 
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
 -d '{"model_name":"rwd-small","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}]}'
```
This avoids the SDK route mapping entirely.
alex_support: repro steps captured. @lee_sdk can you confirm why `model` became undefined in the SDK payload? That looked like a serialization bug in 0.22.0 we haven't seen before.
lee_sdk: yep — another issue: we changed the public param name on the API from `model` -> `model_name` in the spec, and the SDK v0.22 had a transient bug where it reads config from a stale generated types file if built from certain monorepo caches. That results in `model` not being set on the outgoing body. The combination of wrong route + wrong param name produced the errors you saw. Fixed in 0.23.1 where we regenerate the types and add a backwards-compatible mapping for `model`.
jorge_customer: ok thanks. How long until that 0.23.1 is safe for us to roll across all CI workers? Anything we need to change in config?
lee_sdk: 0.23.1 is published and includes the mapping + a no-op resiliency layer. No config changes required. If your CI pins package-lock, update the lockfile and run a canary deploy on staging. If you can't upgrade immediately, the curl fallback will work.
nina_backend: also logging note — we added a diagnostic header `x-rw-route-fallback: true` when a shim mapping was used; if you see that in responses it means the client used the compatibility layer.
jorge_customer: saw that header in some responses earlier. Any ETA on when backend will stop accepting old route?
nina_backend: we will keep accepting old names for 48 hours then deprecate. We can extend if you need more time but prefer customers to upgrade.
alex_support: I'll leave this thread with a checklist: 1) Upgrade to @redwood/inference@0.23.1 in staging and run smoke tests. 2) If blocked, use direct REST `chat.generate` curl as temporary workaround. 3) If you still see undefined params, share a full minimal repro tarball and we'll run it in our sandbox.
jorge_customer: thanks all — starting the upgrade process now. Appreciate the quick turnaround. :thumbsup: 
ci-bot: deploy queued for staging (job 8452) — will post status.
ci-bot: staging deploy succeeded (job 8452) — no regressions on smoke tests.
ale x_support: glad to hear it — marking this support ticket as triaged. Reach out if anything else pops up.
